summary: Iteration 6 - Driver toggle-ready and Admin modules/updates features fully tested. All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for both driver toggle and admin updates tab.

driver_toggle_ready: Toggle-ready actually toggles the online status (true->false->true)
Toggle-ready requires driver role (403 for customers)
admin_modules: POST /api/admin/modules creates a module with name, description, version
admin_updates: POST /api/admin/update/upload accepts ZIP file and returns parts_updated
existing_flows: Customer auth flow with test code 1234 works
Admin login with admin@taxi.local / admin123 works
frontend_driver_toggle: Driver main page shows 'Выйти на линию' button (data-testid='toggle-ready-btn')
Button is disabled when rules checkbox unchecked
Button is ENABLED after checking rules checkbox
Clicking toggle changes status to 'На линии' (online)
Clicking go-offline changes status back to 'Не на линии'
frontend_admin_updates: 'Обновления' tab visible in admin sidebar navigation
'Загрузить обновление' section with ZIP drop zone present
Module toggle and delete buttons present

critical_code_review_comments: Driver toggle-ready fix: Removed user.is_online sync inside useEffect that was overwriting local state. Added isReadyRef for WebSocket handler. refreshUser() called after toggle to sync context.
Admin modules CRUD: Full create/read/toggle/delete functionality working
Admin updates: ZIP upload extracts to /app/backend/updates/ directory, stores history in MongoDB
Button text changes dynamically: 'Выйти на линию' (green) when offline, 'Уйти с линии' (red) when online
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test users
context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver toggle-ready feature fully working: button changes text/color instantly without page reload. Admin 'Обновления и модули' tab fully functional with ZIP upload, module CRUD, and update history. SMS/Push notifications remain MOCKED - test code 1234 always accepted.
